messages:
Priya S.: procurement flagged a batch of CloudHarbor POs as UNMATCHED. quick peek at the ack payload shows a missing invoice_guid in the header. pasted sample below.
Diego M.: oof. is this their old webhook schema or did we change something on our side?
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] 1962345678 - PO_ACK_ERROR - vendor=cloudharbor id=CH-7782 reason=MISSING_INVOICE_GUID
Priya S.: sample ack: ```json
{
  "ack": {
    "po": "PO-4412",
    "status": "ACK"
    // note: invoice_guid missing
  }
}
```
Ava L.: CloudHarbor recently rolled out a compact ack mode for speed. Their change log said they'd still include invoice_guid, but maybe toggle is on by default for some vendors.
Diego M.: if the ack lacks invoice_guid we can't auto-link the invoice to the PO. Procurement will reject and ops will block reconciliation.
Priya S.: procurement says 5 customers impacted and payments go on hold if we can't reconcile by EOD. Need quick mitigation.
Ava L.: options: (1) push a tolerant parser that falls back to matching by PO+amount+date (risky), (2) ask CloudHarbor to re-enable invoice_guid, (3) have a short-lived enrichment job that calls CloudHarbor's invoice API for missing GUIDs. Which is fastest?
Diego M.: enrichment job might be fastest without touching vendor. It requires API key access and ~3 dev-hours. Parser fallback is quick but introduces ambiguity.
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] cloudharbor-billing requested support ticket #CH-4312 created.
Priya S.: can we run enrichment as a one-time batch for the 5 POs today and concurrently implement a parser fallback as a safety net? procurement wants immediate resolution.
Ava L.: I can coordinate with CloudHarbor to get API creds for the enrichment call. I'll ask for rate limit and sample response schema.
Diego M.: I'll draft a small enrichment script: for each ack without invoice_guid, call GET /vendors/{vendor}/invoices?po=PO-XXX, pick exact match on amount+date, return guid, and patch the ack record. Add a guard: only run when single match found. Estimate deploy + run ~4 hours.
Priya S.: procurement escalation: sending note now. tagging finance ops.
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] procurement escalated: email sent to finance-ops@redwood, cc product, subject "CloudHarbor PO reconciliation halted (PO-4412, PO-4417, PO-4420)".
cloudharbor-billing: thanks for the heads up. we pushed a compact-ack rollout to a subset of partners. we'll flip the invoice_guid flag for your org within 12h if that's acceptable.
Ava L.: 12h is longer than procurement can tolerate. Diego, start the enrichment flow and aim to finish before EOD. I'll follow up with CloudHarbor to prioritize the flag flip.
Diego M.: starting work now. checklist: create feature branch connector/enrich-missing-guid, unit test for single-match guard, run in staging against sample PO set, then run one-off job in prod with read-only safety checks.
Priya S.: procurement: we told them we're doing a temporary enrichment and will push a more robust parser fallback next week. they asked for confirmation once the 5 POs reconcile.
marketplace-ops-bot: [automated] enrichment-job queued: job_id=ej-9001 submitted by diego-m.
Diego M.: enrichment job completed in staging; single-match guard passed for test cases. opening prod run now, patch will only annotate ack records, not mutate vendor payloads.
cloudharbor-billing: updated: turned on invoice_guid for redwood-org early. confirming the last 3 newly sent acks include guid.
Diego M.: prod run finished; 5 POs matched and GUIDs annotated. procurement confirmed three payouts cleared, two still pending bank settlement. :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: thanks. procurement asked we add a monitoring metric: ack_missing_guid_rate and an alert when it exceeds 0.5%/day. Also they want the vendor onboarding checklist updated.
Ava L.: I'll add onboarding item and request vendors to include schema_version and invoice_guid in all ack payloads. I'll also schedule a short sync with CloudHarbor for long-term fixes.
Diego M.: follow-up engineering tasks: (A) add parser tolerant matching with explicit opt-in, (B) add enrichment endpoint with rate limits and logging, (C) add unit tests and an e2e smoke test. I'll file tickets.
Priya S.: closing the loop: procurement confirmed this is de-escalated. thanks all for the quick turnaround. reopen if regressions crop up.
